parsed.summary: The PR introduces a new handler for refining the argument of complex numbers, which seems to address the issue. The change is minimal and well-structured.

issues.description: The handler does not cover all possible cases for the argument of complex numbers, such as when the argument is zero or when the number is purely imaginary.
The docstring for the new handler could be more detailed and include examples for different scenarios.
